summary.title: Profile
summary.text: Software Architect and Full-Stack Developer with 9+ years of experience in end-to-end solution design, software development and technical leadership. Specialist in .NET/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, microservices, Clean Architecture and Azure, with experience in CI/CD, system optimization and Agile environments. Certified in TOGAF and Azure Solutions Architect Expert, with a track record leading technical decisions, mentoring developers and building scalable solutions for international teams and markets.

bullets: Oversee the SDLC and technical decisions, ensuring scalable solutions, code quality and on-time delivery.
Lead the development of Dafne, an AI-based professional assistant integrated into the platform to enhance user interaction.
Design cross-platform solutions with .NET MAUI and React Native, optimizing interfaces and functional behavior.
Guide junior developers through code reviews and Clean Architecture principles.
Technically lead the El Asturiano account, aligning development decisions with business goals for the Canadian market.
Develop scalable full-stack architectures, translating business requirements into technical solutions.
Optimize Agile development flows to streamline delivery in a high-demand agency environment.
Develop a custom CRM, reducing maintenance costs by 10%.
Design data models and application components focused on the maintainability and evolution of the CRM.
Apply software quality practices to detect defects before production release.
Design and lead the technical implementation of Geo CX, ensuring system scalability and performance.
Mentor junior developers in architecture best practices, code standards and Clean Architecture.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical problems and strengthen system stability.
